sentences.en: Juha and his son went to the market.
They had one donkey on the road.
At first both of them walked on foot.
People on the road looked at them.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: יש להם חמור והם הולכים.
sentences.en: They said: they have a donkey and they walk.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא הרים את הבן על החמור.
sentences.en: Juha lifted the son onto the donkey.
They continued on the road a little more.
Other people saw them.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: תראו את הילד הזה.
sentences.en: They said: look at this child.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: האבא הזקן הולך ברגל.
sentences.en: They said: the old father walks on foot.
Juha got up, and the son got down.
They went like that for half an hour.
Women on the road saw them.
They said: what a father he is.
They said: the small child gets tired.
Both of them got on the donkey together.
The donkey walked very slowly.
An old man stopped them on the road.
He said: this donkey is small.
He said: and you are two on it.
Juha got down and the son got down after him.

sentences.ar: הם הרימו את החמור על הכתפיים.
sentences.en: They lifted the donkey onto their shoulders.
The whole market laughed when they came in.
Juha said to the son: did you see?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אי אפשר לרצות את כולם.
sentences.en: He said: it is impossible to please everyone.
